citations.title: Coupling of Phosphorylation to Electron and Hydrogen Transfer by a Chemi-Osmotic type of Mechanism
citations.relevance: The paper that proposed ATP is made by pumping protons across a membrane and letting them back through. It is the mechanism the whole battery framing rests on.

citations.title: Mitochondrial Genetics: A Paradigm for Aging and Degenerative Diseases?
citations.relevance: Argues that defects in oxidative phosphorylation sit underneath a range of degenerative disease. Contested because it is a proposed paradigm rather than a settled finding.

citations.title: Phototransduction by Retinal Ganglion Cells That Set the Circadian Clock
citations.relevance: Shows a distinct class of retinal cell carries light to the circadian clock without rods or cones. This is why the protocol treats light as timing information rather than as an energy input.

citations.title: Avoidance of sun exposure as a risk factor for major causes of death: a competing risk analysis of the Melanoma in Southern Sweden cohort
citations.relevance: A cohort followed for two decades in which women who avoided the sun had higher all-cause mortality. Observational, so it cannot separate sun exposure from everything that travels with it.

citations.title: UVA Irradiation of Human Skin Vasodilates Arterial Vasculature and Lowers Blood Pressure Independently of Nitric Oxide Synthase
citations.relevance: Controlled exposure in people, lowering blood pressure through nitric oxide stored in skin, by a route vitamin D does not explain. Contested because it is one small trial.

citations.title: The Omega-3 Index: a new risk factor for death from coronary heart disease?
citations.relevance: Defines the Omega-3 Index as EPA plus DHA in red cell membranes. The reason that exact measurement is on the panel rather than a general fatty acid panel.

citations.title: Cardiorespiratory Fitness as a Quantitative Predictor of All-Cause Mortality and Cardiovascular Events in Healthy Men and Women: A Meta-analysis
citations.relevance: Meta-analysis tying cardiorespiratory fitness to all-cause mortality. The reason VO2max is measured at both ends rather than treated as a gym number.

citations.title: A randomized controlled clinical trial of a Wim Hof Method intervention in women with high depressive symptoms
citations.relevance: 84 women randomised to cold exposure with breathwork, or to slow breathing with warm showers. Both groups improved about the same amount, roughly 24% on depressive symptoms. A single unreplicated trial, which is why cold and breathwork are carried in the protocol as contested rather than established.
